item.title: Stardelve - Read & Publish SciFi Stories
item.description: Stardelve is a fiction writing website along the veins of Wattpad, RoyalRoad, etc. designed specifically for hosting SciFi stories. It was my first major dive back in to web development with a fullstack project

item.title: Single Page Website
item.description: I built Anapop.casa, a personal one-page website for a friend of mine that was looking to provide a dogwalking and petsitting service. It was built using Astro and has i18n support for Portuguese, as well as English

item.title: YouTube Progress Tab
item.description: built an extension to solve an ever-present personal problem of mine. It lets me find which of many dozens of open youtube tabs had videos I had partially watched before moving on. You can find it for Firefox and Chrome (did you know you have to pay google a registration fee to upload extensions?)

item.title: Squeeshie IDLE RPG
item.description: I used Go to make a discord Idle RPG Game called Squeeshie Idle RPG. It was only used amongst friends and never released, though I plan to come back and continue its development. It uses Go with the Discord websocket API via https://github.com/bwmarrin/discordgo. User data is saved as JSON to a Postgres database. It was hosted on GCP and also has integrations with Prometheus, Grafana, and Alert monitoring

item.title: Portfolio
item.description: This portfolio website was built using Hugo, a Static Site generator for markdown files, written in Go. It gets automatically built and published on every change by Github Actions

item.title: IM Tools
item.description: IM Tools was a local DIY store near my college. Our assignment was to design and create a possible website for their review. It can be found here.
